title: IoT Smart Desk Orchestrator
bullets: Designed an ESP32-based smart desk monitor integrating 7 hardware components via MQTT.
Synced hardware status with a Tkinter desktop app using event-driven C++ logic, eliminating polling delays.

title: Embedded Smart Pin Locker
bullets: Designed an ATMEGA2560 Smart Pin based Locker with tamper detection, hardware timed lockouts.
Used a 4X4 Keypad, 16X2 LCD, Stepper Motor, Buzzer for functional presence.

title: CoreInventory
bullets: Production grade inventory management system with RBAC, SMTP OTP verification, Multi-Device support, built to be self-hosted.
